devdoc.author: Origin Protocol Inc
devdoc.details: This implementation supports multiple Liquidity Providers (LPs) with single buy and sell prices. It also integrates to a CapManager contract that caps the amount of assets a liquidity provider can deposit and caps the ARM's total assets. A performance fee is also collected on increases in the ARM's total assets.

params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

devdoc.title: Lido (stETH) Automated Redemption Manager (ARM)

FEE_SCALE().notice: The scale of the performance fee 10,000 = 100% performance fee

MAX_CROSS_PRICE_DEVIATION().notice: Maximum amount the Owner can set the cross price below 1 scaled to 36 decimals. 20e32 is a 0.2% deviation, or 20 basis points.

activeMarket().notice: The address of the active lending market.

addMarkets(address[]).notice: Owner adds supported lending market to the ARM. In order to be a safe lending market for the ARM, it must be:  1. up only exchange rate  2. no slippage  3. no fees.

allocate().notice: Deposit or withdraw liquidity assets to/from the active lending market to match the ARM's liquidity buffer which is a percentage of the available assets. The buffer excludes liquidity assets reserved for the ARM's withdrawal queue. That is, more liquidity assets will be withdrawn from the lending market if the ARM's liquidity asset balance does not cover the buffer, which can be zero, and the ARM's outstanding withdrawals. Will revert if there is no active lending market set.

allocateThreshold().notice: The minimum amount of liquidity assets in excess of the ARM buffer before the ARM can allocate to a active lending market. This should be close to zero.

armBuffer().notice: Percentage of available liquid assets to keep in the ARM. 100% = 1e18.

asset().notice: The liquidity asset used for deposits and redeems. eg WETH or wS Used for compatibility with ERC-4626

baseAsset().notice: The asset being purchased by the ARM and put in the withdrawal queue. eg stETH

capManager().notice: The address of the CapManager contract used to manage the ARM's liquidity provider and total assets caps.

claimDelay().notice: The delay before a withdrawal request can be claimed in seconds. eg 600 is 10 minutes.

claimLidoWithdrawals(uint256[],uint256[].notice: Claim the ETH owed from the redemption requests and convert it to WETH. Before calling this method, caller should check on the request NFTs to ensure the withdrawal was processed. Withdrawal NFTs that have been transferred in from another account will be reverted.

claimRedeem(uint256).notice: Claim liquidity assets from a previous withdrawal request after the claim delay has passed. This will try and withdraw from the active lending market if there are not enough liquidity assets in the ARM. If there is not enough liquidity in the ARM and lending market the transaction will revert. If the lending market has enough liquidity but has high utilization preventing the withdrawal, the transaction will revert. If the assets per shares has decreased since the redeem request, the asset value of the redeemed shares at claim is used.

claimable().notice: Used to work out if an ARM's withdrawal request can be claimed. If the withdrawal request's `queued` amount is less than or equal to the returned `claimableAmount`, then the withdrawal request can be claimed.

collectFees().notice: Transfer accrued performance fees to the fee collector This requires enough liquidity assets (WETH) in the ARM that are not reserved for the withdrawal queue to cover the accrued fees.

convertToAssets(uint256).notice: Calculates the amount of liquidity assets for a given amount of shares

convertToShares(uint256).notice: Calculates the amount of shares for a given amount of liquidity assets

crossPrice().notice: The price that buy and sell prices can not cross scaled to 36 decimals. This is also the price the base assets, eg stETH, in the ARM contract are priced at in `totalAssets`.

deposit(uint256).notice: deposit liquidity assets in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) shares. The caller needs to have approved the contract to transfer the assets.

deposit(uint256,address).notice: deposit liquidity assets in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) shares. Funds will be transferred from msg.sender.

fee().notice: Performance fee that is collected by the feeCollector measured in basis points (1/100th of a percent). 10,000 = 100% performance fee 2,000 = 20% performance fee 500 = 5% performance fee

feeCollector().notice: The account or contract that can collect the performance fee.

feesAccrued().notice: Calculates the performance fees accrued since the last time fees were collected

getReserves().notice: Get the available liquidity for a each token in the ARM.

initialize(string,string,address,uint256.notice: Initialize the storage variables stored in the proxy contract. The deployer that calls initialize has to approve the ARM's proxy contract to transfer 1e12 WETH.

lastAvailableAssets().notice: The available assets the last time the performance fees were collected and adjusted for liquidity assets (WETH) deposited and redeemed. This can be negative if there were asset gains and then all the liquidity providers redeemed.

lidoWithdrawalQueue().notice: The address of the Lido Withdrawal Queue contract

lidoWithdrawalQueueAmount().notice: The amount of stETH in the Lido Withdrawal Queue

lidoWithdrawalRequests(uint256).notice: stores the requested amount for each Lido withdrawal

liquidityAsset().notice: The address of the asset that is used to add and remove liquidity. eg WETH This is also the quote asset when the prices are set. eg the stETH/WETH price has a base asset of stETH and quote asset of WETH.

minSharesToRedeem().notice: The minimum amount of shares that can be redeemed from the active market.

nextWithdrawalIndex().notice: Index of the next withdrawal request starting at 0.

operator().notice: The account that can request and claim withdrawals.

owner().notice: The contract owner and proxy admin.

paused().notice: True when user-facing ARM actions are paused.

previewDeposit(uint256).notice: Preview the amount of shares that would be minted for a given amount of assets

previewRedeem(uint256).notice: Preview the amount of assets that would be received for burning a given amount of shares

registerLidoWithdrawalRequests().notice: Register the Lido withdrawal requests to the ARM contract. This can only be called once by the contract Owner.

removeMarket(address).notice: Owner removes a supported lending market from the ARM. This can not be the active market.

requestLidoWithdrawals(uint256[]).notice: Request a stETH for ETH withdrawal. Reference: https://docs.lido.fi/contracts/withdrawal-queue-erc721/ Note: There is a 1k amount limit. Caller should split large withdrawals in chunks of less or equal to 1k each.)

requestRedeem(uint256).notice: Request to redeem liquidity provider shares for liquidity assets

setARMBuffer(uint256).notice: Set the ARM buffer which is a percentage of the available assets.

setActiveMarket(address).notice: set a new active lending market for the ARM. This can be set to address(0) to disable the use of a lending market.

setCapManager(address).notice: Set the CapManager contract address. Set to a zero address to disable the controller.

setCrossPrice(uint256).notice: set the price that buy and sell prices can not cross. That is, the buy prices must be below the cross price and the sell prices must be above the cross price. If the cross price is being lowered, there can not be a significant amount of base assets in the ARM. eg stETH. This prevents the ARM making a loss when the base asset is sold at a lower price than it was bought before the cross price was lowered. The base assets should be sent to the withdrawal queue before the cross price can be lowered. For example, the `Owner` should construct a tx that calls `requestLidoWithdrawals` before `setCrossPrice` for the Lido ARM when the cross price is being lowered. The cross price can be increased with assets in the ARM.

setFee(uint256).notice: Owner sets the performance fee on increased assets

setFeeCollector(address).notice: Owner sets the account/contract that receives the performance fee

setOperator(address).notice: Set the account that can request and claim withdrawals.

setOwner(address).notice: Set the owner and proxy admin of the contract.

setPrices(uint256,uint256).notice: Set exchange rates from an operator account from the ARM's perspective. If token 0 is WETH and token 1 is stETH, then both prices will be set using the stETH/WETH price.

steth().notice: The address of the Lido stETH token

supportedMarkets(address).notice: Lending markets that can be used by the ARM.

swapExactTokensForTokens(address,address.notice: Swaps an exact amount of input tokens for as many output tokens as possible. msg.sender should have already given the ARM contract an allowance of at least amountIn on the input token.

swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256,uint256.notice: Uniswap V2 Router compatible interface. Swaps an exact amount of input tokens for as many output tokens as possible. msg.sender should have already given the ARM contract an allowance of at least amountIn on the input token.

swapTokensForExactTokens(address,address.notice: Receive an exact amount of output tokens for as few input tokens as possible. msg.sender should have already given the router an allowance of at least amountInMax on the input token.

swapTokensForExactTokens(uint256,uint256.notice: Uniswap V2 Router compatible interface. Receive an exact amount of output tokens for as few input tokens as possible. msg.sender should have already given the router an allowance of at least amountInMax on the input token.

token0().notice: The swap input token that is transferred to this contract. From a User perspective, this is the token being sold. token0 is also compatible with the Uniswap V2 Router interface.

token1().notice: The swap output token that is transferred from this contract. From a User perspective, this is the token being bought. token1 is also compatible with the Uniswap V2 Router interface.

totalAssets().notice: The economic value of assets in the ARM, active lending market and external withdrawal queue, less the liquidity assets reserved for the ARM's withdrawal queue and accrued fees. The active lending market is valued using ERC-4626 share conversion rather than current redeemable liquidity.

traderate0().notice: For one `token0` from a Trader, how many `token1` does the pool send. For example, if `token0` is WETH and `token1` is stETH then `traderate0` is the WETH/stETH price. From a Trader's perspective, this is the buy price. From the ARM's perspective, this is the sell price. Rate is to 36 decimals (1e36). To convert to a stETH/WETH price, use `PRICE_SCALE * PRICE_SCALE / traderate0`.

traderate1().notice: For one `token1` from a Trader, how many `token0` does the pool send. For example, if `token0` is WETH and `token1` is stETH then `traderate1` is the stETH/WETH price. From a Trader's perspective, this is the sell price. From a ARM's perspective, this is the buy price. Rate is to 36 decimals (1e36).
